name: Reassignment: the map and the in-world tracker both mark Major Samuelson in the keep war room (#12166)
contract: Quest 563 'Reassignment' ends at Major Samuelson 2439. rev_20260923_03_coa_stormwind.sql moved him (guid 16182) into the CoA keep war room at (-8407.6, 214.4, 155.347); the reporter of #12166 confirms him there (SexyMap 86.8, 35.6) while the marker stays at the stock spot (-8421, 405), ~190 yd away. The quest has one POI (id 0, ObjectiveIndex -1, WorldMapAreaId 301). This case sends the CMSG_QUEST_POI_QUERY a real client sends and requires the single point to be Samuelson's spawn rounded to the integer grid (-8408, 214). The in-world arrow and minimap pin are a second, independent route: QuestSuperTrack row 2464 (quest 563) resolves completion to SuperTrack node 1318, which the client ships at the stock spot (-8421.0, 404.99, 120.89); only row 2464 references node 1318. The core streams coa_client_super_track rows at login (SMSG_PATCH_SUPER_TRACK, 0x06BE), and the last assertions require row 1318 to stand on Samuelson's spawn with the client's own MapID 0, radius 5.5 and NextID 0. These are data assertions rather than a run: the harness cannot see what the client draws.
